steps.name: a_treecube_home
steps.desc: alpine seed 1234, the installed treecube palette, home view, fades off

steps.name: a_treecube_close
steps.desc: treecube, zoomed to size 14 at the map centre; the camera is left alone by the switch

steps.name: b_plantgen_close
steps.desc: plantgen, same camera as a_treecube_close (not reset), scatter regenerated from the same biome painting

steps.name: c_treecube_home
steps.desc: back to treecube, home view: equal to a_treecube_home when the overlay is fully removed

steps.title: treecube against plantgen foliage, same map
steps.intro: A new 200 ft alpine map (seed 1234), built once in authoring and never saved. a_* with the installed treecube palette (home, then size 14 at the map centre); the foliage_library op then serves the plantgen package (D:/dev/plantgen/out/ttsim_package_plantgen_all, nine biomes) and reopens the map from its document in memory, which regenerates the scatter from the same biome painting: b_* are the same two cameras (never reset), so ground, rocks (shared assets) and framing match and only the plants differ. c_treecube_home returns to treecube and should equal a_treecube_home. Occlusion fade, close-zoom canopy fade and the brush fade are held off, the wind is frozen.
